hooks.command: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -f "$root/CLAUDE.md" ] || exit 0; changed=$(git show --name-only --pretty=format: HEAD 2>/dev/null); echo "$changed" | grep -qx 'MEMORY.md' && exit 0; substantive=$(echo "$changed" | grep -vE '^(MEMORY\.md|TODO\.md|README\.md|CLAUDE\.md)$' | grep -v '^$'); [ -n "$substantive" ] && echo "WARNING: this commit changed substantive files but did not touch MEMORY.md. Per this repo's CLAUDE.md: add a dated MEMORY.md entry (not just a TODO.md checkmark) before moving on." >&2; exit 0
